name: Cibao Cafe
notes: MapQuest lists it explicitly 'Cibao Cafe - CLOSED, 9449 Balboa Ave, San Diego, CA 92123'. A direct Google Maps business search on the exact address returns no restaurant at all - only offices (chiropractic, psychotherapy, ATF field office, sports rehab, dealer services) - confirming the space has been repurposed. Yelp's own listing also carries a CLOSED tag. Permanently closed, no food successor at the address.

name: Urban Kitchen Market
notes: Urban Kitchen Market is a food stand at the Rady Shell at Jacobs Park (San Diego Symphony's outdoor venue), 200 Marina Park Way. Read from the venue's own 2026-season PDF menu (linked from theshell.org/plan-your-visit/food-and-drink/) via pdftotext -layout; small full menu, no truncation, no markup pattern (mix of .50/.95 and flat-dollar prices, consistent with a printed concession menu). 'A Potato Bar' is a distinct sub-menu, prefixed in section.

name: Las Pinches Tortas
notes: www.laspinches.com is fully dead (DNS does not resolve, not just a broken page). Yelp's own listing states plainly 'Yelpers report this location has closed' at the exact address (558 Jamacha Rd, El Cajon). UberEats/Grubhub/Postmates listings are stale marketplace pages (UberEats shows 'Not accepting orders'). Treating as permanently closed for this restaurantId.

name: Cluckin' Bell
notes: This was a GTA-themed pop-up (by Smokin J's BBQ) at 751 4th Ave, San Diego. Take-Two Interactive issued a cease-and-desist over the trademark and the pop-up was permanently rebranded to 'Don't Cluckin' Tell' in 2023 (confirmed by rockstarintel.com and pcgamer.com). Cluckin' Bell no longer exists as a business name at any address - not-found for this record, not permission to borrow the successor's menu under this id.
